Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite

Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite – Available with 2 or 4 Bedroom Option
Introducing Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite
Combining traditional baronial style with an abundance of modern luxuries, Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite is a truly welcoming home from home which sits high above the West Coast of Scotland. Spanning across 418 square metres/4,500 square feet, this elegant four bedroom penthouse suite (accommodating up to 8 guests) encompasses the entire top floor, and is accessible through a private elevator. Watch the sunset, afterward marvelling at the stars whilst you take in the breath-taking views of the iconic Ailsa Craig, our dramatic, local island, the Isle of Arran, and the Mull of Kintyre.
This sprawling, self-contained penthouse suite is home to four luxurious bedrooms each with their own magnificent bathroom plus a sauna, beauty & treatment room, library & games room, media room, period kitchen and a private dining & lounge area for up to 16 guests. A private rooftop terrace offers you 360 degree views of the estate and coastline. The Castle Penthouse Suite has full Butler service and Private Chef available upon request with a supplement charge. This truly unique Suite provides a high level of security, is totally self-contained and at the same time, is connected with the main Hotel and all of its amenities.
The 2 bedroom configuration covers two-thirds of the entire floor and consists of a library & games room, media room, spacious lounge & dining room and period kitchen in addition to the two bedrooms, two bathrooms and access to the roof of the Castle.
ENQUIRE NOW
View Floorplan
Take The Tour
History and Splendour
Glenapp’s rich and storied history is reflected throughout the castle. Over the last 150 years, merchants, aristocrats and philanthropists have all called this beautiful castle home, and each left their mark. The strongest of those links is that of the First Lord Inchcape, once the Chairman of P&O. Sir James Mackay would stand atop the castle and gaze out to sea, keeping an eye on his ships as they sailed past.
A stay in the Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite allows guests to experience Glenapp more like a home than a hotel. Venture out onto the roof and make the most of the endless views of grounds, gardens, the untamed landscape surrounding the estate, and across the sea to Ireland.
Enquire Now
View Availability
Scottish Luxury
Whether in the 2 or 4 Bedroom Option
The Penthouse Suite's collection of stunning bedrooms and bathrooms are ideal for families or groups of friends to call home for a short stay or long-term vacation on the Scottish west coast. Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite features four individually designed bedrooms: The Elsie Mackay, The Poppy Wyndham, The Kintyre, and The Waverley. In each, you’ll find a super king size bed, which can also be set up as twin single beds, fresh flowers, and luxurious bathrobes and slippers.
All bedrooms and bathrooms boast stunning sea views, featuring roll top baths, walk in showers, as well as bespoke toiletries and thoughtful amenities.
Enquire Now
View Availability
Dining
Additionally, a stay in Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite can also include, upon request with a supplement charge, your own private chef, who will be on hand to prepare your dinners on any evening, as well as your personal butler, who will be on hand to serve and recommend a fine selection of cocktails and drinks to accompany your dining. You will be able to chose from our gourmet three-course dinners, or perhaps wish to experience the delicious seven-course tasting menu with a specially selected wine flight. Your private chef will prepare your daily breakfast to order and this can be enjoyed watching the Chef at work in the bespoke kitchen or in the main dining room in Glenapp Castle Penthouse Suite. Whatever you choose, dining will be a memorable experience. Dining is also available each day for breakfast, lunch and dinner in the main Castle Dining Rooms on the first floor. Your butler will be on hand upon request, discreetly, throughout your stay. They will be there to meet you on arrival, help arrange your activities and experiences, oversee all your dining preferences, recommend your wines and anticipate your wishes.
The services of your private chef and personal butler are available with a supplement charge - please contact our team today for further information.
Enquire Now
View Availability
Indulge and Unwind
Whether you’re in need of a long-overdue massage or simply want to pamper yourself with a facial or manicure, our experienced beauty therapists are on hand to help. Our beauty therapists will also be available for a pre-dinner makeover.
For those who want to keep up with their fitness routine? You’ll find yoga mats, weights and hula hoops waiting for you. The Suite has its own private sauna and treatment room which means you can relax without leaving the Suite.
Enquire Now
State of the Art Entertainment
The media room has a 65” TV hidden behind a guild mirror. Features include Netflix, Amazon, Sky TV, and Disney+. The media room is the perfect place to enjoy cosy nights in, or to arrange the all important video conference call. You will find Bluetooth speakers, Xbox with games, VR Oculus Quest 2 and the Suite has its own super fast fibre Wi-Fi connection. Next door, in the library and games room, which we call our no-tech room, you will find an eclectic offering of books, board games, chess set and wonderfully comfortable seating. A perfect room for a wee dram after dinner over your favourite game.

Our Guest Suites
Relax in one of the 17 meticulously designed Castle Bedroom Suites, all with their own style, size and story, each one lavishly decorated and many with sea views and in-room cosy fireplaces. Or, perhaps you wish to stay in the largest hotel suite in Scotland, the magnificent Castle Penthouse Suite, with four bedrooms as well as a sauna, treatment room, library, a media room, a period kitchen and dining room, and including a private chef and butler. Additionally, our nature-immersed one-bedroom Garden Cottage Suite is located in the walled gardens with its own wellness sanctuary.
All of the public rooms at the castle are on the first floor. There are suites on the ground, first and second floors, with the Castle Penthouse Suite spanning across the entire third floor. All of these are accessible by lift, though some are more suitable than others for guests who have difficulty with stairs. The Castle has good disability access - please simply ask at the time of reservation if you require these facilities.

FAQs - Glenapp Castle
FAQs
Scroll to explore
Book now
Frequently Asked Questions
Welcome to Glenapp Castle, where luxury, history, and natural beauty combine to create unforgettable experiences. To help you plan your perfect stay, we have compiled answers to our most frequently asked questions.
General FAQs
What is the history of Glenapp Castle?
Built in 1870, Glenapp Castle is a magnificent Scottish baronial Castle nestled in the heart of Ayrshire. This historic treasure has been lovingly restored to its former glory, maintaining its period features while offering all modern luxuries. The Castle sits within 36 acres of stunning gardens and woodland, providing a tranquil escape surrounded by breathtaking Scottish landscapes.
To read more about Glenapp Castle’s fascinating history, click here .
What is the best time of year to visit?
Each season at Glenapp Castle offers its own unique charm. Spring brings blooming gardens, summer offers long days perfect for outdoor adventures, and autumn transforms our grounds with spectacular colours. Winter creates a cosy atmosphere with roaring fires, frosty mornings, and crisp air, along with the festive cheer of the season. Our doors are open year-round, welcoming guests to experience the magic of Glenapp in every season.
Where is Glenapp Castle located?
Glenapp Castle is located on the scenic Southwest Coast of Scotland, at the following address:
Glenapp Castle
Ballantrae
Ayrshire
KA26 0NZ
Scotland, UK
To view our location on Google Maps, click here.
How do I reach Glenapp Castle?
By Car: The Castle is approximately a 90-minute drive from Glasgow and 2.5 hours from Edinburgh.
By Train: The nearest station is Girvan, approximately 25 minutes from the Castle. The largest nearby station is Ayr, around 50 minutes from the Castle.
By Air: Glasgow Airport is the closest international airport (90 minutes away), with Edinburgh Airport also easily accessible (2.5 hours away). Prestwick Airport is a smaller local airport (1 hour away) and is perfect for private jets, as well as several European destinations. Helicopter landing facilities are also available in the castle grounds.
By Helicopter: Helipad landing facilities are also available in the Castle grounds.
By Sea: We have a private jetty for those wishing to arrive by boat.
Transfers: Our dedicated team of chauffeur drivers are on hand to collect or drop off guests throughout the United Kingdom. Please contact our Reception Team for your bespoke quotation.
For further details on our location and directions, please click here .
Booking Policies
What is your reservation/cancellation policy?
For fully refundable bookings made on regular rates, a deposit equal to the first night’s stay per room is charged at the time of booking and is fully refundable if cancelled prior to 1500 hours 14 days before arrival; cancellations within 14 days are non-refundable and guests are advised to have travel insurance.
Promotional rates and bed and breakfast promotional offers require full payment at booking and are non-refundable. Special offers also require full payment at booking and are non-refundable; however, monies can be held for 12 months from the original reservation date.
For reservations using a pre-purchased gift voucher, the voucher number must be provided at booking; cancellations must be made more than 14 days before arrival to retain voucher validity, while cancellations within 14 days result in forfeiture, with monetary vouchers subject to the applicable rate’s terms.  Please note that voucher expiry dates are final and not extendable, ensuring that all guests can enjoy their experience within the designated time frame.
In the event of cancellation by the hotel, all payments will be refunded in full, although the hotel is not liable for any client-incurred costs, and all guest cancellations must be submitted in writing. Bookings must be confirmed with deposit payment within 3 days of a provisional booking, or the accommodation may be released, and the hotel will endeavour to make contact to advise accordingly.
Accommodation
How many bedrooms does Glenapp Castle have?
In total, Glenapp Castle has 22 luxurious bedrooms.
Firstly, Glenapp Castle has 17 individual Castle Bedroom Suites, all completely unique in terms of colour, size and style, spanning across the following five room categories:
Garden View Suite
Grand Garden View Suite
Grand Sea View Suite
Junior Suite
Master Suite with Sea Views
Moreover, the further four bedrooms can be found in the Castle Penthouse Suite which offers 4,500 sq. ft of luxury, making it the largest hotel suite in Scotland, with a 4-Bedroom and 2-Bedroom option. It includes a media room, library & games room, period kitchen, lounge & dining room, sauna, beauty & treatment room and a rooftop viewing terrace with panoramic views, alongside private elevator access and personal concierge service. The additional services of private chef and personal butler are also available with a supplement charge.
Lastly, nestled in the heart of Glenapp Castle’s historic 1830s walled garden, The Nest is a nature-immersed, one-bedroom Garden Cottage Suite. Wake to birdsong, breathe in pristine Ayrshire air, and step from your door into a private outdoor wellness sanctuary complete with a secluded sauna and invigorating cold plunge tub, beneath some of Scotland's most remarkable dark skies.
Most of our rooms have cosy working fireplaces, and many offer spectacular sea views. Additionally, many of our bedrooms can offer twin-beds, with interconnecting and accessible options too – simply contact our Reservations Team who will be happy to recommend the most suitable bedrooms for you to ensure the most comfortable stay.
